senses.gloss: f., pl. כּוֹבְעוֹת (preced. wds.) the tops of stalks of sheaves.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:8">Peah V, 8</cite> <he>המעמר לכ׳</he> he who binds sheaves for covering the stalks; expl. Y. ib. V, end, 19ᵃ <he>מן לעיל</he> sheaves to be put on top, opp. <he>לכומסות</he>; v. <cite ref="K00288"><he>כּוֹמְסָה</he></cite>.
